General prefabricated building buyers (industrial sheds, warehouses, modular offices) who are siblings in the same taxonomy parent — names that omit the horticultural/propagation function and read as generic prefab structures would attract the wrong buyer segment and collide semantically with siblings such as 'Prefabricated Buildings', 'Modular Buildings', or 'Greenhouse'; all enhanced names therefore retain explicit propagation or nursery qualifiers.

General greenhouse/polyhouse buyers (crop cultivation, not propagation) represented by siblings 'Greenhouse', 'Polyhouse', 'Naturally Ventilated Greenhouse', 'Agricultural Greenhouses' — names must retain the misting/propagation qualifier to distinguish mist chambers from general growing structures.
